SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   C. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
